Lemma
[decay evolution for the trace-free Hessian] Source: cao-zhu 1. Lemma 5.1.8\group Normalized Ricci Flow on Surfaces

We have \begin{equation} \frac{\partial }{\partial t}|M_{ij}|^2 =\Delta |M_{ij}|^2-2|\nabla _k M_{ij}|^2-2R|M_{ij}|^2, \; \text{ on }\; M\times [0,+\infty ). \end{equation}
